web-development.title: Professional Websites
web-development.short: Premium business websites designed to look sharp and convert visitors.
web-development.description: A website that explains who you are, builds trust fast, and leads visitors to a clear action.
benefits: A site your team can manage
web-development.forWho: For businesses, brands, and service providers who want a digital home that stands out — and turns attention into real conversations.
problems: Your site looks outdated and undersells you
Traffic comes in — but enquiries don’t

faq.q: Can we update the website ourselves after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We set up a simple update workflow and train your team so content changes feel easy.

faq.q: Will the site work in Hebrew, Arabic, and English?
faq.a: Yes. We build multilingual sites with full RTL support when needed.

faq.q: How long does a professional website take?
faq.a: Most projects take a few weeks, depending on scope, content readiness, and level of customization.

landing-pages.title: Landing Pages
landing-pages.short: One page. One offer. One clear conversion.
landing-pages.description: Landing pages focused on one goal — turning ad traffic into action.
benefits: More leads from the same traffic
landing-pages.forWho: For businesses running ads, offers, or launches that need a dedicated page built to convert — without the distractions of a full website.
problems: You pay for ads — but conversion stays low
The page is confusing with too many goals

faq.q: How is a landing page different from a full website?
faq.a: A landing page is built for one offer and one action. A full website tells the whole brand story across multiple journeys.

faq.q: Can you connect Facebook, Google, and analytics?
faq.a: Yes. We set up tracking for campaigns, forms, and conversions so you can see what works.

faq.q: How quickly can we go live?
faq.a: When the offer and content are clear, many pages launch within a few days.

crm-systems.title: CRM Systems
crm-systems.short: A CRM shaped around how your team actually works.
crm-systems.description: One system for leads, clients, tasks, and follow-ups — so no opportunity slips away.
features: Full client history in one card
crm-systems.forWho: For sales teams, service teams, and business owners who need real control over customers — not another spreadsheet or rigid off-the-shelf tool.
problems: Leads get lost across WhatsApp, email, and Excel
No single view of the customer
Generic CRM tools don’t match your process
process: Train and optimize in real use

faq.q: Will the CRM follow our process?
faq.a: Yes. We adapt the CRM to you — we don’t force your team into a generic workflow.

faq.q: Can you migrate existing clients and leads?
faq.a: Yes. We plan a clean import together, including organizing the data that matters.

faq.q: Can different teams have different permissions?
faq.a: Yes. Each role sees exactly what’s relevant — by branch, department, or responsibility.

mobile-applications.title: Mobile Applications
mobile-applications.short: An app customers open — and teams actually use.
mobile-applications.description: iOS and Android apps with clean UX, solid performance, and connections to your systems.
benefits: Shared foundations that save time and cost
mobile-applications.forWho: For businesses that need a customer app, ordering/service channel, or an internal tool for field teams — without making the experience complicated.
problems: No convenient mobile channel for customers
Field teams depend on desktop or WhatsApp
Separate builds for each platform get expensive
process: Validate the need and key journeys
Publish to stores and support after launch

faq.q: Will the app work on iPhone and Android?
faq.a: Yes. We build cross-platform experiences for both stores.

faq.q: Can it connect to our CRM, website, or existing system?
faq.a: Yes — when an API exists, or when we can build the right connection.

faq.q: Do you help with App Store and Google Play publishing?
faq.a: Yes. We support preparation, submission, and the review process.

web-development.headline: The website that makes people understand you — and reach out.
web-development.body: Not just a pretty site. We build a fast, clear digital presence that matches your brand — and turns interest into calls, quotes, or sales.
web-development.promise: Goal: explain your value in seconds, then guide visitors to action.
web-development.goal: Build a digital home that strengthens trust, sets you apart, and generates quality enquiries consistently.
web-development.introTitle: A website that works for the business — not just the portfolio.
web-development.introBody: You get premium design, clear structure, strong mobile performance, and paths built for conversion. After launch — a simple update flow for your team.
web-development.outcome: You end with a live site that represents you properly.
web-development.outcomeBody: A presence that respects the brand, loads fast, and is ready to grow with you — with clear metrics for continuous improvement.
web-development.processLead: We work in short stages with full transparency — from discovery to launch.

landing-pages.headline: One page that turns ad traffic into real leads.
landing-pages.body: When you run campaigns, every second counts. We build a landing page with one message, one offer, and one clear button — so your ad budget works harder.
landing-pages.promise: Less noise. More action. A page that points visitors exactly where they should go.
landing-pages.goal: Raise campaign conversion and turn clicks into leads, bookings, or sales.
landing-pages.introTitle: A sharp conversion path — without distractions.
landing-pages.introBody: Strong headline, clear benefits, trust signals, and the right call to action. Everything aims at one outcome: leave details or buy.
landing-pages.outcome: A page ready for ads — with tracking that shows what works.
landing-pages.outcomeBody: You’ll see which ads bring leads, improve messaging quickly, and launch new versions without starting from scratch.
landing-pages.processLead: Speed with precision: define the offer, build, launch, and improve with data.

crm-systems.headline: A CRM that ends the chaos — and puts every customer under control.
crm-systems.body: Leads in WhatsApp, undocumented calls, follow-ups that break between people. We build a system that centralizes your customer lifecycle — around how your team actually works.
crm-systems.promise: Every lead has an owner. Every conversation has a place. Every stage is tracked.
crm-systems.goal: Turn sales and service into an organized, measurable process — even as the team grows.
crm-systems.introTitle: The system adapts to you — not the other way around.
crm-systems.introBody: Pipelines, permissions, tasks, and reports are built around your real process. Result: less chaos, more closes, and a clear view for leadership.
crm-systems.outcome: Full control of leads and customers — at every moment.
crm-systems.outcomeBody: The team knows the next step, leadership sees real numbers, and customers get a consistent experience.
crm-systems.processLead: We start by mapping your process — then build the system that supports it.

mobile-applications.headline: An app customers actually open — and teams actually use.
mobile-applications.body: We build iOS and Android apps that simplify ordering, service, or field work. Clean, fast experiences connected to the systems you already have.
mobile-applications.promise: Not an app for PR — a daily tool that strengthens the customer relationship.
mobile-applications.goal: Give customers and teams easy mobile access — with a simple experience that drives repeat use.
mobile-applications.introBody: We map the key journeys, design clear screens, and ship a stable app for both stores — including notifications and connections to existing systems.
mobile-applications.outcome: A live mobile channel that strengthens loyalty and efficiency.
mobile-applications.outcomeBody: Customers get service at their fingertips, and teams move faster — without depending on desktop or WhatsApp alone.
mobile-applications.processLead: First we confirm clear user value — then we develop and publish to the stores.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about scope, timing, and working together.

cost.q: How much does a website cost?
cost.a: Pricing depends on scope, pages, design level and features. After a short discovery call we provide a clear proposal for your website, landing page, CRM or app.

timeline.a: Landing pages often take days to a couple of weeks. Professional websites usually take a few weeks. CRM systems and mobile apps typically take longer depending on complexity.

crm.q: Do you build custom CRM systems?
crm.a: Yes. We design and develop CRM platforms around your sales and service workflow — not generic templates.

mobile.a: Yes. We build modern mobile apps for iOS and Android for customers and internal teams.

api.a: Yes. When needed we connect CRMs, payments, messaging tools and other services through reliable integrations.

maintenance.a: Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance, updates and technical support after launch.

redesign.q: Can you redesign an existing website?
redesign.a: Yes. We can modernize design, improve performance, rebuild structure and elevate conversion.

smb.q: Do you work with small businesses?
smb.a: Yes. We work with startups, growing companies and established businesses.

scratch.q: Can you build an entire system from scratch?
scratch.a: Yes. From discovery and design to development, launch and support — including websites, landing pages, CRM and apps.

blocks.text: We at MADAR (مدار) ("we", "us", "our") are committed to protecting the privacy of our website visitors and clients. This policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect personal information when you use madar.digital or our development services (websites, landing pages, CRM systems, and apps).

This policy is designed in line with Israel's Privacy Protection Law, 1981, and its regulations. Where relevant (for example for visitors from the EU/EEA), we also follow commonly accepted data-protection principles, including GDPR concepts.
By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described here. If you do not agree, please do not use the site or submit personal information.
When you use our contact form or request a quote, we may collect:

items: Full name
Phone number
Email address
Message / project description

blocks.text: When you browse the site, servers and browsers may record routine technical data, such as:

items: IP address
Browser and device type
Operating system
Pages visited, visit times, and technical server request logs
Language preference stored in the browser (for example via localStorage)

blocks.text: This information is used mainly for operations, security, and site improvement, and is not intended to identify you directly.
We may use essential cookies and local browser storage to operate the site (for example saving interface language). See section 7 for more detail.
We use collected information for:

items: Responding to enquiries and preparing quotes
Providing development services and related project support
Operating, securing, and improving the website
Contacting you through channels you choose (such as email or WhatsApp), at your request
Complying with legal and regulatory obligations

blocks.text: We do not use your information for direct marketing without your clear consent, if and when we offer marketing communications.
We do not sell personal information. We may share information only with providers needed to run the business and website, and only as necessary:
Purpose: receiving and processing contact requests submitted through the website form.
Data that may be processed: name, phone, email, and message content.
Purpose: direct contact when you click the WhatsApp button. The conversation is handled on WhatsApp/Meta platforms under their terms.
Privacy policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
Purpose: website hosting, security, and network traffic. These providers may process technical server logs (such as IP addresses) as part of operating their service.
If we later add analytics tools or other providers, we will update this policy accordingly.
We may disclose information when:

items: Required by court order, legal obligation, or a competent authority
Needed to protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of others
Related to a business transfer (such as a merger or sale), subject to applicable law and reasonable protections

blocks.text: As of this policy update, our main use is essential operational tools (such as language preference). We do not currently run dedicated third-party advertising or analytics tools on the site.

rows: Save interface language and improve usability
According to browser settings / until deleted

blocks.text: You can manage cookies and local storage in your browser settings. Blocking essential tools may affect site functionality.
We take reasonable security measures to protect information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, including:

items: HTTPS encryption where the site is served that way
Limiting access to information on a need-to-know basis
Using commonly accepted infrastructure providers

blocks.text: No electronic transmission or storage method is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes collected, or as required by law. Afterwards we delete or anonymize it where feasible.

items: Contact-form enquiries: up to 2 years from the last enquiry, unless a business relationship continues
Client records linked to a business/accounting engagement: according to Israeli record-keeping duties (often up to 7 years, as applicable)
Technical logs: for a reasonable period needed for security and operations

blocks.text: Under Israeli privacy law, and under other laws that may apply to you (including GDPR rights where relevant), you may be entitled to:

items: Access personal information we hold about you
Correct inaccurate information
Request deletion, subject to legal duties or legitimate business needs
Object to use of your information for direct marketing, if applicable
Receive information about how your data is used

blocks.text: To exercise your rights, contact hello@madar-il.com. We aim to respond within 30 days, subject to legal requirements.
To request deletion of personal information, email hello@madar-il.com and include details that help us locate your request (such as the email or phone you used).
We may be unable to delete information we must keep by law (for example accounting records), or information needed for legal defense.

Our website and services are not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you learn that a minor provided us information, please contact us so we can delete it.

Some infrastructure or communication providers (such as WhatsApp) may process information on servers outside Israel. In such cases we rely on recognized providers and commonly accepted safeguards where applicable.
We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page, and the "Last updated" date at the top will reflect the latest revision.
